style_rules.language: Bundled Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi, preserving OFL notices.
style_rules.hub: White header and three stream buttons; 1280px content width, 24px desktop padding. Paper cards form three columns, then two at1100px and one at700px; 9px corners, 1px slate borders and18px gaps.
style_rules.exam: Scrollable full-width question pane with local text passages and labelled radio options. Under901px the question palette overlays as a focus-contained drawer, closed by default. Actions and timer wrap on narrow screens.
style_rules.results: Phone score tiles stack; section tables scroll within their panel; question review retains readable type and original option order.
style_rules.forms: Dialogs contain focus, close with Escape and return focus. Header/footer remain reachable while a long form scrolls. Primary controls use white text on blue; status colours have text labels.
